description: This file defines the HiveSession interface, which specifies methods for managing Hive database sessions, including executing queries, retrieving metadata, and handling delegation tokens.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes the session with provided configuration map.

methods.name: executeStatement
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement with a query timeout.

methods.name: executeStatementAsync
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement asynchronously with a query timeout.

methods.name: getSchemas
methods.description: Retrieves schema information for specified catalog and schema.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Retrieves table information based on parameters.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column information for a table.

methods.name: getPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key information for a table.

methods.name: getResultSetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a result set.

methods.name: getNoOperationTime
methods.description: Returns the time since last operation.
